subject: English
passage: The ______ Adi Das's paper on high-pressure superconductivity has been very positive. Many physicists have praised the findings, and the paper won the American Physical Society's annual research prize.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer because it most logically completes the text's discussion of how Adi Das's paper has been received. In this context, 'reception of' means the way something is received or responded to by an audience. The text indicates that the response to the paper has been very positive, with many physicists praising the findings and the paper winning a research prize. This context supports the idea that the reception of the paper has been very positive.
